name: qdrant_tool
description: Hybrid semantic + BM25 search against airkit Qdrant collections (playbooks, detection_rules, incident_history). Read-only — this tool never writes to Qdrant; ingestion of new playbooks/rules/history happens through a separate offline indexing process, not through the agent.

tools.name: search_vector_playbooks
tools.description: Hybrid search a Qdrant collection and return the top matching chunks with their payload.

query.description: Natural language query, e.g. 'containment steps for ransomware on a domain controller'.

top_k.description: Number of top results to return.

category_filter.description: Optional: restrict results to entries whose applies_to_categories / mitre_attack_techniques overlap this list.
